text:
Priya: Seeing loglevel flip during startup of onboarding-node sample. First few logs are INFO then DEBUG with request-id later, which confuses users.
Arjun: That's usually OTEL hook or async exporter registering after logger autoconfig. Which SDK version?
Priya: Using redwood-sdk@1.2.9 in the sample. Env LOG_LEVEL=info. Startup: require-sdk -> configure routes -> init otel -> listen.
Arjun: Two quick fixes: 1) early logger bootstrap (call SDK.initLogger(...) immediately at top of entry); 2) add a lightweight req-id fallback middleware before handlers so first logs have an id.
Priya: Can you paste minimal middleware?
Arjun: ```
// top.js
const { initLogger } = require('redwood-sdk');
initLogger({ level: process.env.LOG_LEVEL || 'info' });
app.use((req,res,next)=>{ req.id = req.headers['x-request-id'] || Date.now().toString(36); next(); });
```
qa-bot: Recommend adding integ test: start sample with LOG_LEVEL=info and assert no DEBUG lines before a request-id header exists.
Priya: Also found PII leak: emails in headers show up in DEBUG. Current sample regex is too narrow. Use SDK redactHeaders or a stronger pattern: `(?:[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+)@(?:[A-Za-z0-9.-]+)\\.[A-Za-z]{2,}`
devex-bot: Created issue devex/samples#4987 to track: "onboard-node: early logger bootstrap + req-id fallback + better header redaction + test"
Priya: I'll open a PR with small changes and update the quickstart note.
Arjun: I'll review the PR. Thanks!
